title: 第6章 下载二第7章 出院
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
一道道字迹不断在胡隆眼前浮现。
并不是每个人都有属于自己的技能。
虽然面板并未向他提供这方面的信息，但是在胡隆这些天的观察分析下。
技能的形成条件并不简单，比如吃饭，睡觉，骑自行车这种基础技能是不会形成技能的。
技能并非人人都有，这里似乎藏着一条无形的标准。
在胡隆看来，像吃饭、走路、唱歌这类人人都会的事，当然算不上技能。
只有当某项能力超出寻常，才会成为真正的技能。
比如，唱歌要唱到足够动听，才能被称作一种“本领”。
只有需要通过大量时间学习能够掌握的技能才能被显示出来。
不，或许是这太素面板会参考胡隆本身做出改变。
比如别人掌握了他不会的技能。
当然这些胡隆的猜测，至于是否是这样，他也并不确定。
这也是为什么有些人没有技能，而有一些人则是会有不止一个技能的原因。
除此之外。
不一样的技能，就算是处于同样层次，需要的流量也会有一些细微的差异。
比如有的熟练层次技能需要3M，而有的则只是需要2M。
胡隆来到一个靠近窗户位置坐好，确保自己能够充分的晒到太阳，护工则是去给他排队打饭去了。
在他前面的座位，是一个头发花白的老人，正极其认真地将碗里的米饭一粒一粒排列在桌面上，动作缓慢而专注。
远处，右侧则是一个中年女人对着空气频频点头，嘴角挂着凝固的微笑。
而胡隆看似在盯着窗外。

实际上并非如此，心中一动，太素面板浮现而出。
视线落在最后一栏。
【源值:6.71缕】
距离他来到这个世界，已经过去了一个月半。
源值达到了6.71缕。
按照原本一天可以增长0.1源值的进度计算。
源值应该会增长差不多4.5缕，加起来最少也有7缕多。
但是事实却不是这样。
他目前所处的环阳市地处属于于荆江下游，冷暖气在此区域长时间对峙，会形成准静止的“梅雨锋”。
导致夏季时常出现连绵数周的阴雨天气。
阴雨天气，会遮挡阳光的照射。
这也使得其中几天胡隆根本没有办法获取源值。
“吃饭了！嘿嘿，我最喜欢吃饭了，我要吃鸡腿……”
content_en:
One after another handwriting appeared in front of Hu Long's eyes.
Not everyone has their own skills.
Although the panel did not provide him with this information, under Hu Long's observation and analysis these days.
The conditions for skill formation are not simple. Basic skills such as eating, sleeping, and riding a bicycle will not form skills.
Not everyone has skills, and there seems to be an invisible standard hidden here.
In Hu Long's view, things that everyone can do, such as eating, walking, and singing, are certainly not skills.
Only when an ability is beyond the ordinary does it become a true skill.
For example, singing must be beautiful enough to be called a "skill".
Only skills that require a lot of time to learn can be displayed.
No, maybe this Taisu panel will be changed with reference to Hulong itself.
For example, someone else has mastered a skill that he does not know.
Of course, he was not sure whether these Hu Long's guesses were true.
This is why some people have no skills, while some people have more than one skill.
besides.
Different skills, even at the same level, will require slightly different flows.
For example, some proficiency level skills require 3M, while others only require 2M.
Hu Long came to a seat near the window and sat down to ensure that he could fully enjoy the sun, while the caregiver went to line up for him to get food.
The seat in front of him is an old man with gray hair, who is arranging the rice in the bowl on the table one by one with great care, his movements are slow and focused.
In the distance, on the right side is a middle-aged woman nodding to the air with a frozen smile on her lips.
Hu Long seemed to be staring out the window.
In fact, this was not the case. With a thought, the Taisu panel appeared.
His eyes fell on the last column.
[Source value: 6.71 rays]
It has been a month and a half since he came into this world.
The source value reached 6.71 rays.
Calculated based on the original progress of increasing the source value by 0.1 per day.
The source value should increase by almost 4.5 strands, which adds up to at least 7 strands.
But this is not the case.
The Huanyang City where he is currently located is located in the lower reaches of the Jingjiang River. The long-term confrontation between cold and warm air in this area will form a quasi-stationary "Meiyu Front".
This often leads to weeks of rainy weather in the summer.
Rainy weather will block sunlight.
This also made it impossible for Hu Long to obtain the source value for a few days.
"It's time to eat! Hehe, I like to eat the most. I want to eat chicken legs..."
